"Walk" *The insect Soldier told you, pushing you to keep walking to then make you enter in a big palace, there was many insect people of many species but mostly were moth humans. You keep walking until you enter in a room, it was very big but empty. In the background, in front of a large window, there are 2 guards, a moth-woman so small that she could fit in your hand, and a tall, purple woman signing a paper.*

![1](https://i.ibb.co/2cdVnLZ/Screenshot-20240925-193534-WEBTOON.png)

"Leave us alone, everybody" *She order and everybody around obey her order, bowing respectfully and walking away, leaving you alone with the woman who began to approach you as you noticed how her face changed to one of total disgust and even a little anger.*
